prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: this 2x2 atlas of a black studio microphone on an upright floor stand. Keep TOP ROW exactly unchanged. Rebuild ONLY bottom-row HEADS. BOTTOM RIGHT: mirrored orientation: FRONT rounded oval grille at UPPER RIGHT aimed toward camera; solid BLACK METAL REAR at LOWER LEFT, sloping down. This is a single microphone capsule with ONE mesh front half and ONE solid metal rear half, NOT a double-ended grille, NOT a second microphone. Bottom heads should look like the same original microphone tilted in the opposite pitch, not a new fully-mesh tube. Front faces must be visible and elevated, opposite solid backs lowered. Stand remains perfectly vertical and unchanged. Transparent RGBA background, 2x2 even sprite cells, fully isolated full height microphones, generous gutters. No text, markings, arrows, floor, cast shadows, or checkerboard. Match original warm isometric hand-painted furniture game style.
